pages.title: Proposed governance structure after the transfer

label.value: Proposed governance structure after the transfer

fields.tooltip:
Upload an A4 diagram of the organisation chart and other information.

The diagram should provide the structure and role of members, trustees, committees, any sub committees and any local governing bodies.

Also include any formal scheme of delegation and any information about how a proposed multi-academy trust structure will work in practice. In particular, how it will hold the chief executive officer or executive principals to account.
